findings.title: Stale directory buttons remain active during navigation
findings.evidence: crates/blit-gui/src/app.rs:81 detects that a browse is loading, but crates/blit-gui/src/app.rs:89 still collects and renders the previous listing as active buttons. The triggering condition is navigating to a directory whose asynchronous listing has not completed, especially a remote directory.
findings.predicted_failure: A conventional double-click on a remote directory can process the old row twice: after the first click changes the current path to `/photos`, the second click joins the stale `photos` row onto that new path and requests `/photos/photos`. The first request is superseded, leaving the user in an unintended directory or showing a missing-path error. This is MEDIUM impact because ordinary navigation can produce an incorrect destination.
findings.better_approach: Clear the listing when navigation begins, or render existing rows disabled/hidden while `is_loading()` is true. Add a regression test that starts navigation while a prior listing is present and verifies stale rows cannot dispatch another `NavigateTo`.
